name: Lost Connections
source:
Lost Connections is a visual novel that's based on a true story about self improvement and courage. Will you build up the courage to get her number, or will everything end up going wrong?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2471780/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《Lost Connections》是一部根据真实故事改编的视觉小说，讲述自我成长与勇气。你能鼓起勇气，要到她的电话号码吗？还是一切都会搞砸？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2471780/]Steam[/url]]
